# Cortico extension tags

Pick every tag below that fits and list it in `cortico.tags` in package.json. The console market groups and filters extensions by these tags and shows the hover hint to users.

```jsonc
"cortico": { "kind": "world", "api": 5, "tags": ["im", "qq", "companion"] }
```

## How to choose

- Choose by **what the extension connects to and what it lets the bot do**, not by how it is built. Calling an HTTP API is not `browser`; connecting to QQ is `qq`.
- An add-on pack for another extension carries its host's platform tag (QQ add-ons carry `qq`).
- Tag only what truly fits, not to appear in more filters. Use `apps` only when no other tag fits. If nothing fits, leave it empty and maintainers will correct it.
- Platform limits go in the standard npm `"os"` field (`["win32"]`, or `["!darwin"]` to exclude), not in tags.
- Notice and warning tags count only when listed in `cortico.tags`; `keywords` map to plain tags only.
- Run `pnpm check:extension <dir>` afterwards; tags outside this list are reported.

## Who adds and removes

| Level | Author | Maintainers |
|---|---|---|
| Official mark (blue) | cannot declare; ignored if listed | add and remove |
| Plain | add and remove | add and remove |
| Notice (yellow) | add; remove only what the author added | add and remove |
| Warning (red) | add; once any version declares it, it stays | add and remove |

Declare notice and warning tags yourself where they apply. Their absence means "not declared and not reviewed yet", not "safe".
To remove a tag added by maintainers, or withdraw a declared warning tag, open an issue in this repository titled `[tags] package-name`. The [README](README.md) gives the request format.

## Notice tags

| id | Label | When to use | Hover hint shown to users | Existing examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `experimental` | Experimental | The author marks it as still in testing: features not settled, verified only in a few setups, or compatibility unconfirmed. | Marked as still in testing; features and compatibility may change. | `cortico-world-qq-final-beta` `cortico-world-buckshot` |
| `internal-state` | Internal state | The World keeps and injects the bot's own internal state: mood, affinity, memories, experiences. We recommend building this into a bot extension's Persona instead. | This World manages the bot's internal state (mood, affinity, memories) outside the bot's Memory, so the bot's sense of itself may differ before and after it is installed or removed. | `cortico-world-memory` `cortico-world-life-alont1` `cortico-world-humanlike-alont1` `cortico-world-affinity-alont1` and 8 more |
| `requires-extension` | Requires other extensions | This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README. Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream. Bot extensions do not get this tag. | This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README.<br>Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream. | `cortico-world-gemini-web` `cortico-world-qq-affinity` `cortico-world-qq-admin` `cortico-world-qq-festival` and 12 more |
| `high-cost` | High token use | Makes the bot call the model often or with large context, such as high-frequency events, continuous screenshots or video frames, or long injected text. | This extension may use tokens quickly. | `cortico-world-minecraft` `cortico-world-bilibili-video` |

## Warning tags

| id | Label | When to use | Hover hint shown to users | Existing examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unsafe` | Unsafe | The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write arbitrary files, or freely control the mouse and keyboard. | The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write any file, or control the mouse and keyboard. | `cortico-world-python` |
| `sensitive-data` | Reads private data | Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone, foreground window or spending records, and sends it to the model endpoint with model calls. | Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone or windows, and sends it to your configured model endpoint. | `cortico-world-humanlike-alont1` `cortico-world-gaming-alont1` `cortico-world-alive-alont1` `cortico-world-asr` and 1 more |
| `unofficial-api` | Unofficial API | Calls a service through a web login session, a CLI quota or an undocumented endpoint; this may break the service's terms and put the account at risk. | Uses a login session or undocumented endpoint; may break the service's terms and put the account at risk. | `cortico-world-gemini-web` `cortico-provider-gemini-web` |

## Proposing a tag

Once at least 3 published extensions would use the tag, open an issue titled `[new-tag] id` or a PR against `index.json`. Give the label and hover hint in Chinese and English, and `when` in English.
